tags.note: The signage at this intersection says all three roads at the T are named Marine Drive. Only the road leading south has another sign concurring with this -- the roads leading east and north dispute this.
the signpost for 143rd Pl NE and 39th Dr NE is here, not at the intersection (driveway), believe it or not!
There is no signage to indicate where 88th Avenue Northwest ends and another road begins.

The signage at this intersection is interesting: 136th to the right, 140th to the left, Stimson Rd to the left, and Fire Trail Road overall. The historic name is Fire Trail Road - this seems to be the only intersection mentioning that name.
There actually is a "Stimson Rd" sign at the SW side of this intersection.
